Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement intake: please send vendor onboarding materials to procurement@acme-fintech.com. They use the onboarding form we attached in this reply (I also put it on our shared procurement inbox).
- Security requirements: we will need a current SOC 2 Type II report, answers to our vendor security questionnaire (I’ll attach the questionnaire PDF), and the name of your security contact for a short security review call. Expect a 2–3 week review for security artifacts if nothing else blocks.
- Procurement timeline: historically procurement & legal take about 4–6 weeks to complete vendor setup for new vendors, longer if an MSP/contract negotiation is required. If your legal team can accept our standard terms or provide a clean MSA, that shortens time.
- PO / invoicing: finance generally issues a PO once vendor setup is complete. Our Procure-to-Pay team requires vendor banking info and W9 (US). I’m copying procurement here to start the intake.

I’m attaching the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf we use and our standard vendor questionnaire.

On scheduling: once you send SOC2 + questionnaire responses, I’ll set up a security call with our infosec folks next week (availability Tue/Thu morning PT).

—Sofia
Sofia Hernandez
Head of IT Security | Acme Fintech
